text:
Priya Nair: Hey team — Meraki Corp needs question-by-question SIG evidence. They flagged crypto, key custody, and configuration management. I started the sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/meraki-sig (edit). Can we get screenshots + paths by EOD? cc @Liam Ford @Nora Li
Liam Ford: Will do. I can pull KMS CMK policy and the rotation schedule screenshot from prod-console. Note A.3 asks for rotation frequency; our policy is 90 days (shorter than 'annual') so that's fine. I'll add the console export JSON too.
Nora Li: I'll fetch the 'Key Custody' canonical clause from Confluence and paste into the evidence column. Also will generate a redacted SOC2 excerpt PDF. Where to stage artifacts?
Priya Nair: Use s3://redwood-sales-evidence/meraki/sig-v2/ for this deal, prefix files with "for-review". Put exact s3 path in the sheet cell. Make sure SSE-KMS is used.
Theo Ramos: For on-prem customers they want disk/snapshot encryption proof. I can run snapshot-metadata-export and include SHA256 checksums + image IDs. Will create presigned urls that expire in 48h.
DevSecOps Bot: Automated reminder: new S3 objects detected in redwood-sales-evidence/meraki/. Verify ACL=private and server-side KMS enabled. If public, the bot will alert SecOps.
Liam Ford: Uploaded kms_policy_2026-03-21.png and kms-export-2026-03-21.json to s3://redwood-sales-evidence/meraki/kms/. Confirmed SSE-KMS and private ACL. Added presigned link in the sheet for vendor review (expires 48h).
Nora Li: SOC2_excerpt_redacted.pdf uploaded to s3://redwood-sales-evidence/meraki/compliance/SOC2_2025_redacted.pdf and link added to sheet. Also pasted custody clause under evidence A.2.
Theo Ramos: Snapshot exports and checksums are in s3://redwood-sales-evidence/meraki/snapshots/1898765432/. README includes commands used: `./snapshot-verify.sh --bucket meraki --run-id 1898765432`. Added manifest.json with timestamps.
Priya Nair: Sweet. Two ask items: 1) Can someone add the exact IAM role ARN used to grant cross-account read for Meraki reviewers (they requested it for their risk team)? 2) Make sure any presigned links are single-use and have expiration <= 48h.
Liam Ford: IAM role ARN: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/meraki-reviewer-read. Added to sheet under "IAM-evidence".
Nora Li: All presigned links set to 48h or less. I also redacted customer names in SOC2 and verified metadata.
Priya Nair: Great. I'll bundle and send to Meraki tomorrow AM and keep this thread open until signoff. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
